title: AgentStepResult v1
description: What an AgentStepExecutor returns for one agent step. `usage` is a REQUIRED array of usage-receipt.v1 (design critique finding 3: required-receipts-array wins — it fixes the silent-zero drift both repos carried). It MAY be empty ONLY for status infra_error (the invocation never usably reached a provider); any status that reached a provider records receipts, each floor-enforced by the usage-receipt validator. `output` is present exactly for status completed.

output.description: The step's artifact payload — present exactly when status is completed; validated against the request brief's outputContract by the agent node invoker.

allOf.description: completed requires output; non-completed forbids it.
